examples.scenario: Two overlapping DEM tiles contain different values and filesystem enumeration reverses their order
examples.reason: Default overlap ownership can change solely because input order changed.

examples.scenario: One tile is 1 m resolution and another is 2 m; mosaic uses average resolution
examples.reason: An averaged grid resamples both products and changes candidate extrema support.

examples.scenario: Output uses target-aligned pixels but one tile origin is shifted by half a cell
examples.reason: Aligned output bounds do not prove that source cells share the same lattice.

examples.scenario: gdalbuildvrt accepts projection differences with the allow option
examples.reason: The option ignores projection disagreement and does not transform coordinates.

examples.scenario: A VRT extent includes an uncovered strip and no VRT nodata is set
examples.reason: Uncovered pixels can read as valid zero and become a false minimum.

examples.scenario: Rasterio merge changes from method first to last at a tile overlap
examples.reason: Different overlap ownership can change both minimum and maximum cells.

examples.scenario: A requested source window is partly outside and conversion pads the missing area
examples.reason: Synthetic zero or nodata padding must not enter parcel support or extrema.

examples.scenario: Approximate statistics from overviews report a different maximum than native cells
examples.reason: Extrema require full-resolution values, tied cell indices and exact source-tile ownership.
